snapshot.title: FAA FSDO: NTSB Reportable Event — UAS-02 Class C Incursion

transcript.speaker: FAA FSDO
transcript.text: ASO, this is the FAA Harwick FSDO. We’ve received a report of an unauthorized aircraft in Class C airspace near Harwick. The NTSB has been notified under 49 CFR 800.5. You must begin an NTSB reportable event assessment per HUOG-ERP Section 11.3. Confirm if UAS-02 was airborne above 400 ft AGL and whether it entered controlled airspace. We need a preliminary report by 16:00.

transcript.speaker: ASO
transcript.text: Understood. We confirm UAS-02 exceeded 400 ft AGL and entered Class C airspace. We are initiating the NTSB reportable event assessment now and will submit the preliminary report by 16:00.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms regulatory escalation. The ASO must initiate the NTSB assessment and confirm reporting timelines to the FSDO. Watch for delays in documentation or confusion over reporting thresholds.
